decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match the facing bricks used in the existing two-storey side extension.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall or roof slope of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 86 Rosemary Avenue.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extensions because of their design, appearance and relative position to adjoining properties, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the street scene, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the objectives of the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to house
